claims.text: authorize requires host equality with expected_authority and origin absence or matching HTTP origin, otherwise raising bad_args.
Mutations require the exact origin plus a successful hmac.compare_digest token match, treating TypeError and ValueError as mismatch.
new_token returns secrets.token_urlsafe(32) as a process-local credential granting no domain authority.

decision.rule: Change here when host and origin admission or token comparison needs to change.
decision.failure: Cross-origin mutations are admitted or valid tokens are rejected through comparison handling.
